Woody Marks (BN2, value 6.4/wk) - Upgrade after this week (his best week is now): drop for Kalif Raymond (+4.3/wk)

Waiver: worth a claim - Kalif Raymond (WR, CHI, value 10.7/wk) - Covers your most exposed spot - WR has 8.5 starter-week(s) at risk with Jameson Williams (10.8) behind them; +4.3/wk over your weakest bench, weighted x1.5; fade risk (92% of seasons like his fall off); last 3 weeks 15.5 ppg; rising; drop Woody Marks (+4.3/wk) (also on 2 rival wish list(s))
Morgan is shopping Alvin Kamara, Tyler Warren: nothing there beats what you would have to give - pass, or wait for the price to drop

Week 5 bye: Harrison Butker (K #20) - keep him: the best free K is level with him this week, but #20 at K is not a rank you give away for one bye. Plan: claim Spencer Shrader (IND, 9.9/wk) for that week and drop Woody Marks (RB, 6.4/wk, your least valuable bench man) to hold both; drop Spencer Shrader again in week 6 when Harrison Butker is back
Week 5 bye: Chiefs D/ST (DST #9) - replaceable, and worth no more than Woody Marks. Stream him: claim Texans D/ST (HOU, 6.2/wk) that week in his spot, then take the best free DST back in week 6
Next week: Harrison Butker is on bye - plan the replacement now
Quentin Johnston: 224,945 teams dropped him in the last day (rostered 56%). The crowd is bailing

Timing only: Kalif Raymond (WR) is the likely next pickup for Madeline, Ellie and he values 5.8/wk above your weakest bench WR - worth claiming on his own merit; the rival interest just argues for doing it sooner
